HR trend (bpm)","hideWhenNoData":true},"glossary_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"### About these metrics
- **Body Battery** — Garmin's 0–100 estimate of your energy reserve, charging with rest and draining with stress/activity. **↑ higher is better**; the daily high/low band shows how much you recharged vs spent.
- **Stress** — all-day stress score (0–100) from heart-rate variability. **↓ lower is better**; brief spikes are normal, sustained highs aren't.
- **Respiration** — breaths per minute, split into **Sleep** and **Waking**. **Context** — a lower, stable sleeping rate is generally a good sign.
- **HRV** — overnight heart-rate variability (ms). **↑ higher is generally better** — a sign of recovery and autonomic balance (compare to your own baseline).
- **Resting HR** — your lowest steady heart rate (bpm). **↓ lower is generally better** as an aerobic-fitness proxy.
- **Fitness age** — Garmin's estimate of your aerobic fitness expressed as an age (VO2max-driven). **↓ lower is better** — reads younger than your real age is the goal (compare on the Heart page).
- **Intensity minutes** — minutes of Moderate + Vigorous activity; Garmin/WHO target is ~150/week. **↑ higher is better** (vigorous counts double toward the goal).

_Garmin-specific signals. VO2max shows only if your device reports it._

**Learn more:** [Garmin — Body Battery](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/health-science/body-battery/)"}}},"layout":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":1680,"display":"auto","backgroundImage":{"x":0,"y":0,"src":"/static/app/wearables/bg_health.svg","sizeType":"cover"}},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":120}},{"item":"bb_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":160,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"stress_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":370,"y":160,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"rhr_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":720,"y":160,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"fitage_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":1070,"y":160,"w":350,"h":150}},{"item":"bb_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"stress_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"resp_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"hrv_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"intensity","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":970,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"rhr_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":970,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"glossary_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1290,"w":1400,"h":360}}],"globalInputs":["input_global_trp","input_person"]}}
